mapper.insert: insert into match_tbl(creatorId, title, createAt, startTime, status, location, url, people, kategorie, anonymousCondi, genderCondi, chatCode) values(#{creatorId},#{title},#{createAt},#{startTime},#{status},#{location},#{url},#{people}, #{kategorie},#{anonymousCondi},#{genderCondi},#{chatCode});
insert into chat_tbl(type, hostId, chatTitle) values(#{type},#{hostId},#{chatTitle});
mapper.select: SELECT m.matchId AS matchId, startTime, title, people, status, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.matchId) AS countPeople, t.tag, kategorie FROM match_tbl m INNER JOIN matchparticipant_tbl mp ON m.matchId = mp.matchId LEFT JOIN matchtag_tbl t ON m.matchId = t.matchId GROUP BY m.matchId, startTime, title, people, status, tag, kategorie;
mapper.delete: delete from bookmark_tbl where userId=#{userId} and matchId=#{matchId}
mapper.select: select matchId from bookmark_tbl where userId=#{userId}

select matchId, title, startTime, status, location, anonymousCondi, genderCondi, chatCode, people, kategorie, nickName from match_tbl m join user_tbl u on m.creatorId = u.userId where matchId = #{matchId}
